INSERT INTO agent_conversation_turns AS turn (source_message_id, bot_id, session_id, channel_id, action_id, command)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               ON CONFLICT (source_message_id, bot_id) DO UPDATE SET source_message_id = turn.source_message_id
               RETURNING to_jsonb(turn) AS "value!"
